company_attributes.value: Al Rajhi Banking and Investment Corporation is a Saudi joint stock bank, formed and licensed under Royal Decree No. M/59 (1407H / 1987), headquartered in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It conducts Shariah-compliant banking and investment activities inside and outside the Kingdom through a retail and corporate branch network (545 branches as at 31 December 2025, including branches outside the Kingdom) and wholly owned subsidiaries covering brokerage, asset management and advisory services (Al Rajhi Capital Company), human-resources recruitment services, and foreign branches/subsidiaries in Kuwait, Jordan and other markets providing Shariah-compliant financing, banking and investment services.
